assumptions.trigger: checkpoint unavailable, hash mismatch, model-version drift, or target-domain performance gate failure
assumptions.alternative: stop biological inference; separately benchmark a smaller/open protein encoder and record it as a different model version
assumptions.sensitivity: compare model size and pooling on a held-out homology-cluster split

assumptions.trigger: long proteins or known domain/motif evidence beyond residue 256
assumptions.alternative: pre-registered overlapping-window aggregation with explicit coverage mask; never silently use a different window
assumptions.sensitivity: report 128/256/512 residue-window ablation when hardware permits

assumptions.trigger: alignment collapse, batch-size change, or no improvement on validation loss
assumptions.alternative: pre-register a bounded temperature sweep around 0.1 and report all values

assumptions.default: missing omics/ECP features are masked and never interpreted as measured zero
assumptions.trigger: missingness mask absent or feature vector has non-finite values
assumptions.alternative: exclude that modality for the record and mark it unavailable
assumptions.sensitivity: compare complete-case and mask-aware evaluation without imputing observed values

assumptions.default: public source membership without row-level assay/reference/target organism maps to E4 weak supervision
assumptions.trigger: primary reference, assay, or target-organism metadata is later recovered
assumptions.alternative: manually re-screen the exact row, retain the previous tier in history, and promote only the supported evidence row
assumptions.sensitivity: no numerical sensitivity; evidence-level transition requires provenance

assumptions.default: unlabeled is not negative; explicit assay-negative is kept separately
assumptions.trigger: a data source declares an explicit negative assay result and its assay metadata
assumptions.alternative: add a distinct evidence row with source, assay, reference, and conditions
assumptions.sensitivity: report positive/unlabeled and explicit negative counts separately

assumptions.default: repair truncated source identifiers only by a unique exact normalized-sequence match
assumptions.trigger: zero or multiple raw-source sequence matches
assumptions.alternative: retain original ID, quarantine for manual resolution, and never pick a near-match automatically
assumptions.sensitivity: sequence identity is exact only; homology is not accepted as ID proof

assumptions.default: supervised training requires MMseqs2 90%-identity cluster provenance
assumptions.trigger: MMseqs2 missing, group ID unknown, or cluster crosses split boundaries
assumptions.alternative: block supervised training/evaluation; do not substitute random row split
assumptions.sensitivity: compare identity thresholds only after they are pre-registered

assumptions.default: Ret is unavailable if H2 antigen score, graph, or centrality evidence is missing
assumptions.trigger: required H2/edge inputs fail quality or provenance gates
assumptions.alternative: return null and keep gene unranked, rather than substitute zero
assumptions.sensitivity: change lambda/edge threshold only with a versioned ±20% analysis

assumptions.default: random or unvalidated M1/M2 heads produce unranked AEP rows only
assumptions.trigger: checkpoint hash missing or G-A/G-B/G-C/G-leak/G-safe/G-grade not passed
assumptions.alternative: stop ranking and emit unknown fields plus blocking reasons
assumptions.sensitivity: none; this is a hard operational gate

assumptions.default: ESM-3 is an optional comparator, not a protective-antigen classifier
assumptions.trigger: local open weights/API runtime, permitted use terms, and benchmark are available
assumptions.alternative: keep disabled and continue v1 with ESM-2
assumptions.sensitivity: compare frozen embeddings using the same target-specific cluster split

assumptions.default: Evo 2 is an optional v2 DNA-window backbone and not executed on Windows CPU
assumptions.trigger: supported Linux/WSL2 CUDA environment and exact checkpoint become available
assumptions.alternative: keep v2 scaffold and v1 protein track; do not substitute a protein model for DNA
assumptions.sensitivity: evaluate checkpoint/context-length choice on target-genome holdouts
